description: Free public TradFi reference prices for equities, ETFs, metals, commodities and FX. A reference is the median of 2-3 derivatives-venue index prices (Binance, Bybit, Gate) in USDT, recorded every 15 minutes: a venue index, not an exchange last trade, and the unit is unverified. live is a near-real-time overlay (null when unavailable); freshness is collection time. Omit ticker to page the catalog (latest, 24h/7d change, 24h range, live, key fundamentals). Pass ticker for one instrument with venue constituents, SEC fundamentals, corporate events and history over window, sampled to maxPoints. No API key required.

ticker.description: Catalog ticker such as AAPL or XAU. Omit to list.
